verdict.rationale: Missive documents a REST API whose endpoints cover analytics, conversations, drafts, posts, contacts and labels, plus an MCP server that acts on conversations, contacts, calendar and drafts. Drafts created through the API behave like composer drafts. Nothing documents that the API matches the full UI surface, and many UI features in the evidence have no API equivalent shown, so this is substantial but unproven coverage rather than full parity. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim; documented API coverage of UI features such as snoozing, canned responses, rules/automations, team chat and assignment; an OpenAPI spec (probes found none); independent confirmation of coverage breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
